decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a persistent N-downward shift from ~490 onward with correlated E/U noise, and (2) a sharp U-drop near 605–610 possibly initiating a new trend. Other segments show typical noise or smooth trends without ambiguous superposed changes.

regions.observation: N-component shows a sustained ~2.5 MAD downward shift beginning near index 490, with E and U showing correlated but noisier responses; the N drop appears abrupt over ~5 samples and persists without clear return in this window.

U-component exhibits a sharp multi-sample drop (~4 MAD) around index 605–610, coinciding with a smaller opposing N dip and E fluctuation; the U offset does not recover within the window and may be part of a longer trend starting earlier (index ~590).
